review.verdict: First on Razorgore, second on Flamegor
review.summary: First on Razorgore, second on Flamegor, third on Broodlord and Firemaw, fourth on Nefarian. Average 92, your usual 63.
First of the healers on Broodlord, second on Ebonroc, third on Chromaggus and Nefarian. 10 dispels, 5 of them Flame Shock.

review.verdict: 18 afflictions cleansed, first healer on Firemaw
review.summary: 18 afflictions cleansed on Chromaggus (17 Black), the most. First of the healers on Firemaw, third on Vaelastrasz. Last on Ebonroc and Nefarian.
Ninth on Razorgore, tenth on Broodlord and Ebonroc, parse 90 on Firemaw and Chromaggus. Average 79.
Eleventh on Broodlord and Firemaw (parse 92). Last on Razorgore. Average 64, nearly triple your usual.
Parse 90 on Chromaggus, 87 on Firemaw. Last on Flamegor, 26th on Vaelastrasz, 24th on Ebonroc. Two Fireballs kicked.
Five interrupts, the most in the raid. Parse 97 on Firemaw, 96 on Nefarian, 93 on Ebonroc. Broodlord (17th) was the weak one. Eleven Fire Nova hits on Flamegor, like everyone in range.
Second of the healers on Nefarian, third on Ebonroc, fourth on Firemaw.
First of the healers on Nefarian, second on Chromaggus. Last on Flamegor. 8 dispels.

review.verdict: First on Firemaw and Flamegor, second on four
review.summary: The most damage on Firemaw and Flamegor, second on Broodlord, Ebonroc, Chromaggus and Nefarian, third on Vaelastrasz. Average 93. No deaths.

review.verdict: Tanked every boss, parse 98 on Nefarian
review.summary: Off-tank on every boss but Vaelastrasz: parse 98 on Nefarian, 93 on Broodlord, 92 on Flamegor and Chromaggus. No deaths.

review.verdict: Parse 34, 21st or lower on seven bosses
review.summary: Average parse 34: 25th on Ebonroc and Flamegor, 24th on Firemaw and Chromaggus.
15 dispels: 11 Blue afflictions on Chromaggus and 4 Greater Polymorphs. Third of the healers on Razorgore and Flamegor. Last on Broodlord.
Fourth on Ebonroc, sixth on Chromaggus, seventh on Firemaw. Average 83 against your usual 61.

review.verdict: Last or near last on every boss
review.summary: 8 Red afflictions cleansed on Chromaggus. Healing 9th to 11th on every boss, nothing on Firemaw.

fix.title: Healing
fix.text: Last on Razorgore, Vaelastrasz and Firemaw.

review.verdict: Main tank from Vaelastrasz to Nefarian, parse 97 on Nefarian
review.summary: First of the tanks on every boss from Vaelastrasz on: parse 96 on Vaelastrasz, Firemaw and Flamegor, 97 on Nefarian. Took the Shadow Flames and Shadows of Ebonroc that come with it and never died.

good.title: Tanking
good.text: First of the tanks on seven bosses, no deaths.

review.verdict: Four kicks, dead five seconds into Nefarian
review.summary: Eighth on Vaelastrasz, four interrupts. On Nefarian you took six Shadow Flames, the most, and died at 0:05.
Parse 89 on Nefarian. 27th on Vaelastrasz, 25th on Firemaw and Chromaggus. Average 66, over your usual 48.
The most damage on Ebonroc (65k), fourth on Firemaw, sixth on Vaelastrasz and Nefarian. Average 84, your usual 54.
The most damage on Nefarian (139k, parse 96), fourth on Vaelastrasz, sixth on Broodlord. Average 87 against your usual 67.

review.verdict: Second healer on Broodlord, took Burning Adrenaline
review.summary: Second of the healers on Broodlord. You had the one Burning Adrenaline on Vaelastrasz and nobody died to it. 10th on Vaelastrasz and Flamegor.
Fifth on Razorgore (parse 96), 98 on Firemaw and Nefarian. Broodlord (24th), Flamegor (23rd) and Chromaggus (22nd) were low.
Second of the healers on Vaelastrasz with 25% overheal, fourth on Broodlord, Ebonroc and Chromaggus. 10th on Firemaw.

review.verdict: First death of Nefarian, at three seconds
review.summary: Four Shadow Flames and dead at 0:03 on Nefarian, the first death of the fight. Damage 18th to 26th, average 30 against your usual 46.
Parse 82 on Firemaw. Otherwise 18th to 24th, average 37. One breath on Chromaggus.
Last on Vaelastrasz, Broodlord, Firemaw and Chromaggus. Average 51, your usual.
Fourth on Broodlord, sixth on Firemaw and Ebonroc, seventh on Chromaggus and Nefarian. Average 87 against your usual 55. Clean.

review.verdict: Parse 97 average, 99 on Chromaggus and Nefarian
review.summary: Second on Razorgore and Vaelastrasz, third on Ebonroc and Chromaggus, fifth on Flamegor and Nefarian. Parse 99 on Chromaggus and Nefarian, 98 on Firemaw and Ebonroc, average 97 against your usual 67. Two Fireballs kicked.

review.verdict: Parse 87, and the only trash death of the night
review.summary: Parse 98 on Firemaw, 94 on Broodlord, 93 on Chromaggus, average 87. By place: 20th on Razorgore, 21st on Flamegor, 23rd of 27 on Nefarian, about 18th on average. And on the trash before the drakes a Death Talon Wyrmguard meleed you to death, the only trash death in a raid of 40.

good.title: Parses
good.text: Average 87, a little over your usual.

fix.title: Trash
fix.text: The raid's only trash death, to a Death Talon Wyrmguard.

review.verdict: Every Tranquilizing Shot of the night
review.summary: All five Tranquilizing Shots in the raid: 2 on Flamegor, 3 on Chromaggus. Parse 99 on Nefarian, 95 on Broodlord, Firemaw and Chromaggus. Nobody else tranquilized, so 2 of Flamegor's 4 Frenzies and 2 of Chromaggus' 5 ran.
Not tanking a boss here, and 13th to 26th on all eight. Average 45, over your usual 34.

review.verdict: First healer on Razorgore and Flamegor
review.summary: First of the healers on Razorgore and Flamegor, where 432 Fire Nova hits made healing the whole fight. Third on Broodlord, fourth on Vaelastrasz.
20 dispels and 14 afflictions cleansed on Chromaggus, where you did no healing. Second of the healers on Firemaw. Two Fear Wards on Nefarian.

review.verdict: First on Vaelastrasz, Broodlord and Chromaggus, top five on all eight
review.summary: The most damage on Vaelastrasz, Broodlord and Chromaggus (115k), second on Firemaw, third on Razorgore, Flamegor and Nefarian. Average parse 94 against your usual 69. No deaths.

fix.title: Ebonroc
fix.text: Fifth, the lowest of your raid.

review.summary: Tanked Razorgore, Broodlord, Firemaw, Ebonroc, Flamegor and Chromaggus, with a Fire Protection Potion on Firemaw. No deaths.

review.verdict: Top five on Broodlord, Firemaw, Flamegor and Chromaggus
review.summary: Fourth on Flamegor and Chromaggus, fifth on Broodlord and Firemaw. Average 87 against your usual 61.

review.verdict: Parse 97 on Razorgore and Firemaw, both Veils removed
review.summary: Fourth on Razorgore (parse 97), 97 on Firemaw, 96 on Chromaggus and Nefarian, where you removed both Veils of Shadow. Three Fireballs kicked. Flamegor (22nd) was low.

good.title: Nefarian
good.text: Both Veils of Shadow removed, parse 96.

review.verdict: First healer on Vaelastrasz, Ebonroc and Chromaggus
review.summary: First of the healers on Vaelastrasz, Ebonroc (21%) and Chromaggus, second on Razorgore and Flamegor, third on Firemaw.
Sixth on Flamegor, seventh on Broodlord, parse 94 on Firemaw. Average 79, well over your usual 52. Razorgore (18th) was slow.
Tenth on Vaelastrasz, parse 88 on Firemaw and 84 on Chromaggus and Nefarian. Flamegor (17th, parse 30) and Broodlord (20th) were low.
